mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Ragnarok</titleLeft><mainText>Olaf is immune to disables and has increased Attack Damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Causes the target to become drowsy, then fall asleep. While asleep, the target's Magic Resist is reduced. The first source of damage that breaks the sleep is doubled, up to a cap.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Zoe dropkicks a bubble that deals @TotalDamageTooltip@ magic damage, lingering as a trap if it hits nothing. The bubble's range is extended when flying over terrain.

After a delay, the victim falls Asleep and have their Magic Resist reduced by @PercentPen*100@% for 2 seconds. Attacks and Ability hits wake them up but deal double damage, up to @BreakDamageTooltip@ true damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Before the target falls <status>Asleep</status>, they are <status>Drowsy</status>, becoming increasingly <status>Slowed</status> (up to @Effect5Amount*100@%).</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Asleep</titleLeft><mainText>This target is sleeping. It's Magic Resist is reduced. Damage is amplified against it, but will wake it up.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Wheeeee</titleLeft><mainText>Zoe's moves quickly after casting a summoner spell.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>More Sparkles!</titleLeft><mainText>Zoe's next basic attack after casting a spell deals bonus magic damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: After using an Ability, Zoe's next Attack deals an additional <magicDamage>@PassiveDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>More Sparkles!</titleLeft><mainText>Zoe's next basic attack after casting a spell deals bonus magic damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Zoe fires a missile that she can redirect in flight. Deals more damage the longer it flies in a straight line.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Zoe fires a star that deals increasing damage the further it travels to the first enemy hit and surrounding enemies -- between @TotalDamageTooltip@ to @MaxDamageTooltip@ magic damage.

Zoe can Recast this Ability to redirect the missile to a new position near Zoe.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Blink to a nearby position for 1 second. Then blink back.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Zoe teleports to a nearby position for 1 second. Afterwards, she teleports back. Zoe can use Abilities and Attack, but can't move during this time.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Zoe can also see over walls during the teleport.</rules>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Zoe can pick up the remnants of enemy summoner spell and active item casts and cast them once herself. Whenever she casts a summoner spell, she gains 3 missiles that fire at the nearest target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Enemies drop spell shards when casting a Summoner Spell or using an Active Item. Specific minions also drop a spell shard when Zoe or a nearby ally kills them. Zoe can pick up this shard to cast that ability once.

Passive: When Zoe casts this Ability or any Summoner Spell, she gains @Effect9Amount*100@% Move Speed for @Effect10Amount@ seconds and tosses 3 missiles at the target she Attacked most recently. These missiles deal @MissileDamageTooltip@ magic damage each.

Active: Cast the Ability from a spell shard Zoe has picked up.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Spell shards last on the ground for 40 seconds.
Each missile can apply More Sparkles!
